reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion with a baseline sale
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - 14 AND p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(b.units, 0) AS baseline_units
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id

solver.query:
WITH pr AS (SELECT promo_id, promo_type, discount_pct, start_date, end_date, CAST(end_date - start_date + 1 AS INTEGER) AS days FROM promotions WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'),
pu AS (SELECT ol.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS mar, SUM(ol.line_discount_eur) AS disc FROM sales s JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id WHERE ol.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM pr) GROUP BY ol.promo_id),
bu AS (SELECT pr.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS mar FROM pr JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id AND s.order_date BETWEEN pr.start_date - 14 AND pr.start_date - 1 GROUP BY pr.promo_id),
r AS (SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_type, pr.discount_pct, pr.days, COALESCE(pu.units, 0) AS pu_units, COALESCE(bu.units, 0) AS bu_units, COALESCE(pu.rev, 0) AS pu_rev, COALESCE(bu.rev, 0) AS bu_rev, COALESCE(pu.mar, 0) AS pu_mar, COALESCE(bu.mar, 0) AS bu_mar, COALESCE(pu.disc, 0) AS disc, pu.units AS pu_u_raw, bu.units AS bu_u_raw, pu.mar AS pu_m_raw, bu.mar AS bu_m_raw FROM pr LEFT JOIN pu ON pu.promo_id = pr.promo_id LEFT JOIN bu ON bu.promo_id = pr.promo_id) SELECT promo_id, bu_units AS baseline_units FROM r
